text.what: The Fijian tattooist recorded as still working between 1908 and 1910, when she was the only one left.
text.story: A tradition that ends usually ends without a date. This one has two years and a name, and that is why it sits on this site as a record rather than as a lament.

text_th.what: ช่างสักหญิงชาวฟิจิที่มีบันทึกว่ายังทำงานระหว่างปี 1908–1910 ตอนที่เหลือเธอคนเดียว
